video_title: RJ Says He KNOWS LeBron's Real Plan... And He's Not Telling

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson confirms he knew LeBron James's free agency plans
quotes.excerpt: He told me exactly what was going to happen. He told me the date

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: He told me exactly what was going to happen. He told me the date that he was going to tell the Lakers that he moved. Then he told me where he was going to go. He told me not to tell, but I know the whole plan. Me, him, and Rich Paul, we have been talking.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: They are waiting on some other dominoes to fall, right, to make sure everything is aligned. You know how once he told the Lakers he was not coming back, they signed all the players the next day. So he is just waiting on a couple of things.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's rigorous training regimen and commitment to basketball
quotes.excerpt: Anybody that has had to be this discipline for that long, when we go to Saint-Tropez, it's going to let loose.

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: Anybody that has had to be this discipline for that long, when we go to Saint-Tropez, it is going to let loose. This guy was working out. We were going out there working out, no cap. I saw the Bosu ball. Every time he got the Bosu ball and he goes to put them knees on that Bosu, he is doing this, he is going to start doing medicine ball workouts. He had a gallon of water with him at all times. I hate that fucking jug. He had that jug everywhere.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I hate that fucking jug. He had that jug everywhere.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's prediction for LeBron James's next team destination
quotes.excerpt: Go to San Antonio. Okay, that would be a good move.

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: Go to San Antonio. Okay, that would be a good move.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: So you can't go to Golden State. You can't go to Golden State.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye argues Jalen Brunson is not in the same category as LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: He does not fall in the same category as the San Antonio Spurs. He is 28.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: That motherfucker named Big Body Brunson. He is not 40. Jalen Brunson is one of the young men. He is 28. He does not fall in the same category as the San Antonio Spurs. He is 28. He can shoot the ball for 40 minutes.

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: He is 29. He can shoot the ball for 40 minutes. He will be 30 in August.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson evaluates potential landing spots for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Miami, Cleveland, Golden State are names teams that have been mentioned. Lakers were one of those teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Miami, Cleveland, Golden State are names teams that have been mentioned. Lakers were one of those teams. He is taking them out of the running, in my opinion.

text_blocks.speaker: Tristan Thompson
text_blocks.text: I feel like LeBron could look at Cleveland and say, I don't want that burden.
